notes.title: Resist the succubus—The end of the female Knight is coming!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38391122/661e2dcb0306adb1b62bcd970e1480daeb19a0be.jpg[/img]

BoRoBoRoGame studio's new game Resist the succubus—The end of the female Knight is coming!

As promised by BoRoBoRoGame, this game has high quality CG and beautiful characters.
The English version will be a little late than the Chinese version, but we already had some experienced translator working on it

[h1]Feature[/h1]
[list]
[*] Auto Battler + Galgame
[*] Turn-Based Tactics + Rouglite
[*] Over 30 beautiful CG
[*] Outstanding original sound track
[/list]

Click here to know more about this game!
And don't forget to add to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1868000

notes.title: Fallen girl - Black rose and the fire of desire -----Version update
notes.content:
Thank you very much for your support. The content of this update is as follows:

1. Fixed some bugs that the pictures could not be displayed normally.

2. Fixed some sound bugs.


We are retranslating the English text to enhance the English game experience, which is expected to be launched in August.
